chain.claim: Dutch Bros commits 20 additional labor hours per week (4 hours/weekday, 07:00–10:00) across 12 shops from January 1. Dutch Bros launches a $1 first-time Order Ahead credit (Jan 15–31, up to 100 redemptions/shop across 12 shops = max $1,200 credit cost) via in-app and social media. Dunkin's 15 consenting franchise stores launch a $6 breakfast Meal Deal mobile bundle with local marketing, capped at $20,000 combined promotion and staffing for January. This leverages the app ordering capability (k3) and value positioning (k4) without committing all US franchisees.

Both competitors' incremental morning demand depends on whether Starbucks mobile slot caps actually displace buyers (r2 branch) and whether those buyers' routes pass a participating Dutch Bros or Dunkin location. Dutch Bros' backstory (d.dutch.d7) indicates the regional operator prioritizes service consistency. Dunkin's decision rule (m1.dunkin.a3) to discontinue if economics worsen after one month provides a structural brake; if basket contribution per visit does not clear the discount and added staffing cost, the offer is adjusted or withdrawn in February.

Both competitors' budgets are within declared envelopes and can be executed without external approvals.
